# Order by fewest possibilities (MRV)
def get_possibilities(i, j):
    return [v for v in range(n) if v not in rows[i] and v not in cols[j]]

    if idx == len(empty_cells):
        return True

        grid[i][j] = -1
    # Swap back
    empty_cells[idx], empty_cells[best] = empty_cells[best], empty_cells[idx]
